note: Season months and per person, per night land prices (budget 2-3 star, twin sharing, stay + breakfast + transfers + sightseeing, no flights) gathered from public package listings. Re-check before each season.

shimla.notes: Holidify Shimla-Manali 5N: budget Rs8.5-11k (~1.7-2.2k/night), 3-star Rs14-16k (~2.8-3.2k/night). Christmas/New Year snow week is the priciest.

manali.hub: Kullu-Bhuntar (KUU) airport; most travel by Volvo bus from Delhi
manali.notes: Same Shimla-Manali listings; Manali hotels run ~10% above Shimla in May-June. KUU flights are few (Alliance Air) and pricey; Delhi-Manali Volvo ~Rs1,200-2,000.

dharamshala.notes: Amritsar-Dalhousie-Dharamshala 5N listings Rs11.5k-15.3k (~2.3-3.1k/night), upper end Rs20.4k; 9N Himachal circuits Rs16-24k.

dalhousie.notes: Priced off the same Dalhousie-Dharamshala-Amritsar circuits. Fare is Delhi-Pathankot train (sleeper to 3AC/chair car).

spiti.hub: Chandigarh (IXC) or Kullu-Bhuntar, then road via Shimla/Kinnaur or Manali
spiti.notes: 6N group tours Rs11.6-18.5k (~1.9-3.1k/night); private-cab 3-star Rs30-40k (~5-6.7k/night, incl. dinner). Kunzum/Manali side shut ~Nov-May; Shimla-Kinnaur side open but most hotels close Dec-Feb.

chandigarh.notes: Few standalone packages; estimated from 3-star city hotel tariffs plus a day cab. Mostly a transit stop for Shimla/Manali.

amritsar.notes: Derived from Amritsar legs in Himachal+Amritsar circuits (~2-3k/night). Shatabdi/Vande Bharat train is a cheap alternative (~Rs800-1,500).

leh.notes: Thrillophilia budget Ladakh: 4N Rs15.5k, 5N Rs18.5-19.7k, 6N Rs19.9k (~3.3-3.9k/night); private 6N Rs30k (~5k/night). Permits extra. Leh reachable by air in Jan-Feb but sightseeing very limited (Chadar trek season only).

srinagar.notes: Holidify Kashmir 5N: budget+houseboat Rs11.1-16.5k (~2.2-3.3k/night), 3-star+houseboat Rs14-20.5k (~2.8-4.1k/night). TravelTriangle 5N from Rs20-24k.

gulmarg.notes: Gulmarg hotels cost more than Srinagar; ski season (late Dec-Feb) and New Year snowfall packages are the priciest.

pahalgam.notes: From Kashmir circuit listings. Amarnath Yatra (Jul-Aug) fills hotels; winter is quiet and some properties close.

katra.hub: Jammu (IXJ) airport; Katra has direct Vande Bharat trains
katra.notes: 3N Vaishno Devi packages Rs5-6k budget (~1.7-2k/night) up to Rs13k with private cab (~4.3k). Navratri (Mar-Apr, Oct) and summer holidays are peak.

delhi.notes: Golden Triangle 5N: Tripoto Rs16.8k (~3.4k/night), TravelTriangle 3-star Rs32-34k (~6.4k/night); budget guides Rs12-20k.

agra.notes: From Golden Triangle and Agra-Mathura listings (Rs6-7.5k for 2N incl. car).

mathura.notes: 2N Mathura-Vrindavan: Kiomoi Rs4.9k, Tafri Rs6.6k, Sacred Yatra Rs7.5k (~2.4-3.8k/night); TravelTriangle Rs12-15k. Holi (Mar) and Janmashtami (Aug/Sep) spike sharply.

varanasi.notes: 4N Varanasi-Ayodhya-Prayagraj: Rs12-14k budget (~3-3.5k/night); TravelTriangle 3-star Rs34k (~8.5k, premium). Dev Deepawali (Nov) is the top week.

ayodhya.notes: Same circuit listings. Deepotsav (Oct/Nov), Ram Navami and Prayagraj Magh Mela (Jan-Feb) push rates up; Kumbh years far higher.

rishikesh.notes: 4N Haridwar-Rishikesh-Mussoorie: Rs10.5-15k (~2.6-3.8k/night); TravelTriangle 3-star Rs36k. Rafting shut Jul-Aug.

haridwar.notes: Same Uttarakhand listings, Haridwar hotels slightly cheaper. Char Dham start (Apr-Jun) and Kanwar Yatra (Jul) are busiest.

almora.notes: Few direct listings; scaled from Nainital/Kumaon packages. Mostly homestays and small hotels.

corbett.notes: Resort-style stays cost more; jeep safari usually extra. Dhikala zone open mid-Nov to mid-Jun; only Jhirna/Dhela open in monsoon.

jaipur.notes: Rajasthan multi-city: Wanderon 8D Rs29k (~4.1k/night), Thrillophilia Rs19-37k, Holidify 7N 3-star ~$186-297 (~2.2-3.5k/night).

pushkar.notes: Scaled from Rajasthan circuits. Pushkar Camel Fair week (Oct/Nov) can triple rates.

jodhpur.notes: 3N Jodhpur-Jaisalmer with camp: TravelTriangle Rs10k, Tripoto Rs9.5k, TourTravelWorld Rs10-12k (~3.2-4k/night).

jaisalmer.notes: Desert camps Rs3-8k pp/night (Thrillophilia) in season and mostly shut Apr-Sep. Desert Festival (Feb) is peak.

udaipur.notes: Udaipur-Mount Abu: Waytoindia 3N 3-star Rs8.3k (~2.8k/night), TravelTriangle 3N Rs11.75k (~3.9k), 4N Rs16-26k (~4-6.6k). Monsoon (Aug-Sep) lake season is a mini-peak.

mountabu.notes: Summer (May-Jun) and Diwali are peak, driven by Gujarat weekend traffic.

kutch.notes: Prices are Bhuj 2-3 star hotel plus cab. Rann Utsav tent city (Oct 23 2025-Mar 4 2026) costs ~Rs9-10k pp/night with meals and tours, more on full moon and Dec-Jan. White Rann floods in monsoon and is extremely hot in May-Jun.

dwarka.notes: 4N Dwarka-Somnath: Kiomoi Rs12.65k, Holidify Rs13k, TravelTriangle Rs15.5k, Sacred Yatra Rs15.5k (~3.2-3.9k/night incl. long cab drives). Janmashtami (Aug) spikes Dwarka.

somnath.hub: Rajkot Hirasar (HSR) or Diu (DIU) airport; Veraval rail
somnath.notes: Same Dwarka-Somnath listings. Shravan month (Jul-Aug) and Kartik Purnima fair raise demand.

mumbai.notes: City hotels cost more than hill/beach towns. 2N/3D 3-star packages Rs 5,000-10,500 pp (TourTravelWorld, TravelTriangle) = ~2,500-5,250/night; 4-star TT Rs 17,599 for 2N. Monsoon Jun-Sep is cheapest; Ganesh festival (Aug/Sep) busy but not pricier for packages.

lonavala.hub: Pune (PNQ) or Mumbai (BOM); Lonavala railway station
lonavala.notes: Unusual: monsoon (Jul-Sep) is the PEAK season here (waterfalls, weekend crowds from Mumbai/Pune). MakeMyTrip 2N Lonavala trip Rs 10,543 pp = ~5,270/night; TravelTriangle 2N 4-star Rs 14,500. Summer Mar-May is cheapest. Weekends cost noticeably more than weekdays.

mahabaleshwar.notes: TravelTriangle 2N 2-star ex-Mumbai Rs 9,000 pp = 4,500/night (includes Mumbai transfers); Holidify 2N ~$105 pp = ~2,200/night. Very heavy monsoon (Jun-Sep): many viewpoints and boating shut, hotels discount heavily. Summer holidays (Apr-May) and Diwali/Christmas are peak.

shirdi.hub: Shirdi airport (SAG, few flights) or Mumbai (BOM); Sainagar Shirdi / Nashik Road rail
shirdi.notes: Pilgrim spot, demand fairly even year-round. 2N Shirdi-Shani Shingnapur-Nashik packages Rs 5,120 (Kiomoi), 8,000 (Tafri), 10,500 (TravelTriangle), 10,999 (Sacred Yatra) pp = ~2,500-5,500/night. Guru Purnima (Jul), Ram Navami, Dussehra spike. Watch for Nashik-Trimbakeshwar Kumbh Mela 2027 (approx Jul-Sep 2027) when prices will jump sharply.

goa.hub: Goa Dabolim (GOI) or Mopa (GOX); Madgaon/Thivim rail
goa.notes: 3N/4D 3-star packages: Rs 5,500-7,500 budget, 9,000 (TravelTriangle 3-star), 11,999 (Musafir) pp = ~1,800-4,000/night. Christmas-New Year week can be 2x the peak range. Monsoon (Jun-Sep) cheapest; beach shacks and water sports shut. Flights Delhi-Goa ~3,200 in Jun-Aug, 7,000-13,000 at Dec-Jan.

kochi.notes: Usually sold as the arrival point of Kerala circuits. Derived from Kerala circuit packages (TravelTriangle 2N Kochi+Munnar ~Rs 15,750-17,150; Veena World 6D Kochi-Munnar-Thekkady-Alleppey group tour Rs 49,145). SW monsoon Jun-Aug cheapest (Ayurveda season).

munnar.hub: Kochi (COK), ~4 hrs by road; Aluva/Ernakulam rail
munnar.notes: 2N packages Rs 3,499 (TourTravelWorld), 8,690-9,480 (Flamingo), 8,711 pp = ~1,750-4,700/night. 5N Munnar-Thekkady-Alleppey Rs 17,998 (TourTravelWorld) = 3,600/night; TravelTriangle 4N Rs 22,800 = 5,700/night. Peak is both winter holidays and Indian summer holidays (Apr-May). Monsoon brings landslide risk.

thekkady.hub: Kochi (COK) or Madurai (IXM), ~4 hrs by road; Kottayam rail
thekkady.notes: Rarely sold alone; derived from Munnar-Thekkady-Alleppey circuits (Holidify ~$124-170 pp for 4N; TravelTriangle 5N Rs 31,240-35,500). Periyar boat rides continue in monsoon but are sometimes suspended in heavy rain.

alleppey.notes: Priced as one standard/deluxe private houseboat night incl. all meals. Deluxe AC 1-bedroom: Rs 7,000-15,000 per couple/night (guides; Coco Houseboats ~Rs 13,924 for 2); shared boats from ~Rs 5,999 per couple -> ~3,000-7,500 pp. Dec 20-Jan 5 can be up to 2x base. AC often runs only 9pm-6am. Veena World prices an optional houseboat night at ~Rs 8,000 pp. Nehru Trophy boat race (Aug) lifts August.

kovalam.notes: Thrillophilia 'Coastal Wonders of Kerala' 3N Kovalam+Varkala Rs 15,000 pp = 5,000/night; 'Kerala Treasures' 5N Rs 23,000 pp = 4,600/night. Varkala cliff cafes and many guesthouses close in monsoon (Jun-Aug); sea unsafe for swimming.

madurai.notes: 4N Madurai-Rameswaram-Kanyakumari packages: Rs 11,200-11,500 budget (TourTravelWorld), 16,469-18,116 (TravelTriangle) pp = ~2,800-4,500/night. Temple town; summer Apr-Jun very hot. Chithirai festival (Apr/May) brings crowds.

rameswaram.hub: Madurai (IXM), ~4 hrs; Rameswaram rail (new Pamban bridge)
rameswaram.notes: Same circuit listings as Madurai. Hotels are simpler/cheaper. NE monsoon rain Oct-Dec but pilgrim demand stays high; Aadi/Mahalaya Amavasya (Jul-Sep) spike demand.

kanyakumari.notes: Derived from Madurai-Rameswaram-Kanyakumari(-Trivandrum) 4N circuits (Rs 11,200-29,900 pp). Vivekananda Rock ferry can pause in rough seas (monsoon).

ooty.notes: Peak is Indian summer holidays (Apr-Jun, flower show in May) plus Christmas. 5N Mysore-Coorg-Ooty: Yatra Rs 10,479, TravelTriangle Rs 17,499, DHT Rs 18,990, TourTravelWorld Rs 23,500-26,000 pp = ~2,100-5,200/night.

coorg.hub: Bengaluru (BLR), ~5-6 hrs; Mangaluru (IXE) ~4 hrs; Mysuru rail
coorg.notes: Coorg stays are mostly homestays/resorts and run pricier than Mysore. 2N packages: Rs 9,499 (ex-Bengaluru), Rs 10,102-16,200 (TravelTriangle) pp = ~4,700-8,000/night; budget circuit share ~2,500-4,000. Heavy monsoon Jun-Aug (cheapest).

mysore.hub: Bengaluru (BLR), ~3 hrs; Mysuru Jn rail; Mysuru airport (few flights)
mysore.notes: Dasara (Sep/Oct, 10 days) is the sharpest spike - hotels fill and roughly double. Derived from Mysore-Coorg-Ooty circuits (see ooty).

hampi.hub: Hubballi (HBX) ~3.5 hrs or Bengaluru (BLR); Hosapete rail (Jindal VDY airport has few flights)
hampi.notes: 3N Hampi-Badami: Bharat Booking Rs 12,999, Trawell Rs 12,750 pp = ~4,250/night; Backpackers United Rs 4,999 (hostel) = 1,700/night; Veena World Rs 35,000 (premium group). Apr-May extremely hot (40C+), hence off. Hampi Utsav (Jan/Feb). Many Hampi island guesthouses close in monsoon.

gokarna.hub: Goa (GOI/GOX) ~3 hrs or Mangaluru (IXE); Gokarna Road / Kumta rail
gokarna.notes: 2N packages: TourTravelWorld Rs 6,999-10,999, Thrillophilia Rs 8,199 (ex-Bengaluru), JustWravel Rs 8,900, TravelTriangle Rs 10,369-11,590 pp = ~3,500-5,800/night. Beach shacks and huts close Jun-Sep and sea is unsafe; town (temple) stays open, so listed as off, not closed. New Year week very expensive.

andaman.notes: Incl. private ferry Port Blair-Havelock(-Neil) (Makruzz/Nautika/Green Ocean ~Rs 1,000-1,600 pp each way). 5N packages: TravelTriangle budget Rs 8,299-14,000 (low end looks off-season/shared), Pickyourtrail Rs 13,563, Andaman Shore Paradise Rs 20,000-30,000, andamanislands.com Rs 57,950 per couple = ~2,700-6,000 pp/night. Monsoon May-Sep: ferries and scuba often cancelled. Delhi-Port Blair mostly via Chennai/Kolkata; recent fares seen Rs 11,000-16,000.

shillong.notes: Northeast hotels/cabs cost more than the South for the same star level. 5N Meghalaya: Thrillophilia Rs 19,184-22,000, Holidify Rs 24,500 (incl 1N Kaziranga), TravelTriangle Rs 24,550 pp = ~3,800-4,900/night. Monsoon Jun-Aug: Cherrapunji waterfalls at their best but very heavy rain; Dawki boating and some roads shut.

kaziranga.notes: National park shut for monsoon (roughly mid-May to end-Sep). Reopening is staged: 2025 Bagori range opened 26 Sep, Kohora central range mid-Oct, elephant safari from 1 Nov; 2026-27 jeep safaris from 3 Oct. No true 'off' month - offPrice = shoulder pricing (Apr/May/Oct). 5N Shillong+Kaziranga: TourTravelWorld Rs 39,000 pp (7,800/night, higher tier), Thrillophilia Rs 22,000 incl jeep safari. Jeep safari ~Rs 3,000-4,000 per jeep extra unless included.

darjeeling.notes: 5N Darjeeling-Gangtok budget: TourTravelWorld Rs 12,500-15,999, Rs 24,500 (with Kalimpong) pp = ~2,500-4,900/night; Thomas Cook Rs 37,000-40,500 and SOTC Rs 44,100 are mid/upper tier (~7,500-8,800/night). Peak = summer holidays (Apr-Jun) and Durga Puja/Diwali (Oct-Nov). Monsoon landslides on hill roads. Dec-Feb cold and cheap, but clearest Kanchenjunga views.

gangtok.hub: Bagdogra (IXB) ~4.5 hrs (Pakyong PYG has very few flights); NJP rail
gangtok.notes: Same circuit listings as Darjeeling; Gangtok hotels a bit pricier. Nathula/Tsomgo trips need extra permit + shared cab (~Rs 1,000-1,500 pp); Nathula and North Sikkim (Lachung/Yumthang) roads can close after heavy snow (Jan-Feb) or monsoon landslides (Jul-Aug). Holidify 5N honeymoon ~$164 pp.

bali.notes: Dry Apr-Oct; Jul-Aug + Christmas/New Year busiest; Jan-Mar wet & cheapest. Listings: TravelTriangle 4N Rs27,999 (~7k/n), Thrillophilia 4N Kuta+Ubud 24.5-32k (6-8k/n), Thrillophilia budget 5N 27.8-45k, Pickyourtrail 5N 37,785. Visa = VoA IDR 500,000 (~Rs2,650) + Bali tourist levy IDR 150,000 (~Rs800). No direct Delhi flight; via SIN/KUL/BKK; IndiGo direct from Mumbai/Bengaluru.

bangkok.notes: Cheapest destination on the list. Listings (4N land, twin): TravelTriangle Rs9,599 (~2.4k/n), Musafir budget Rs12,500, Tripoto Rs16,500 and Rs21,069 (flights not incl.), Pickyourtrail Rs21,180. Christmas/New Year and Diwali push peak; Songkran (mid-Apr) is a local spike. Indians visa-exempt; stay cut from 60 to 30 days from 15 Sep 2026; TDAC arrival card free.

phuket.notes: Andaman-coast monsoon May-Oct: rough seas, Phi Phi/James Bond speedboat trips sometimes cancelled, but resorts open and 30-50% cheaper. Listings (5N land): Tripoto Rs23,275 / Rs24,999 (flights not incl., ~4.7-5k/n), Indian Holiday Rs30,500-35,500 (6-7k/n), D Pauls land package; MyTravelCase Rs49,999 is a higher tier. Thai Airways DEL-HKT return ~Rs47k, BOM-HKT ~Rs44k; IndiGo/AirAsia direct budget fares lower.

srilanka.notes: West/south coast best Dec-Mar; SW monsoon May-Sep (east coast good then); Aug Kandy Esala Perahera is a spike. Packages use private car+driver so per-night is higher than Thailand. Listings (5N land): Tripoto Rs23,999, Kiomoi 28,500, Pickyourtrail Rs30,210 / 34,323, Thrillophilia from Rs35,000, Serene Sri Lanka Rs35,999 (twin, min 4 pax). Visa: free for Indians (renewed July 2026, apply online); fallback ETA ~USD 35 if scheme lapses.

kathmandu.notes: Autumn (Oct-Nov, Dashain/Tihar) and spring (Mar-Apr) best; Indian summer-holiday demand May-Jun; monsoon Jun-Aug cheapest, Jan cold. Listings (5N KTM+Pokhara land): Musafir budget Rs17,330 (~3.5k/n), Musafir 3* Rs22,588 (4 pax) - 30,000 (2 pax), Holidify 3* Rs24,500, TourTravelWorld Rs16.5-20.3k (+5% GST) and Rs28,000 (private car). No visa/passport needed (voter ID OK). Mumbai one-way ~Rs10k.

pokhara.notes: Same seasons as Kathmandu; Annapurna views clearest Oct-Nov, monsoon clouds Jun-Aug. Thin data for Pokhara-only: TravelTriangle 2N Rs15,199 and Pelago 2N 3* Rs15,859 both include the KTM-Pokhara transfer (so ~4-5k/n for stay+sightseeing alone); Thrillophilia 3N Pokhara Rs19,899. Flight figures = India-Kathmandu return + ~Rs6-9k Kathmandu-Pokhara domestic return (or ~Rs1,500 tourist bus); Pokhara Intl has almost no India flights.

bhutan.notes: Prices INCLUDE the Sustainable Development Fee of Rs1,200 per person per night for Indian nationals (children 6-12 Rs600; rate confirmed till 31 Aug 2027), plus private vehicle/guide. 5% GST on package components since Jan 2026 (SDF exempt). Paro Tsechu (Mar/Apr) and Thimphu Tsechu (Sep/Oct) bring festival surcharges. Jun-Aug monsoon: landslides, Paro flight cancellations (avoid Jul if possible). Listings: RS Travels 5-day Rs25-40k, Veena World Rs48,000 (twin, GST incl.), TourTravelWorld 5N ex-Bagdogra 3* Rs44,999, Thrillophilia 7-day Rs39,900-80,000 (SDF extra). Flights: low end = flying to Bagdogra + road via Phuentsholing; high end = direct Druk Air/Bhutan Airlines to Paro (DEL-PBH one-way typically Rs32-40k). No visa; free entry permit with passport/voter ID.

singapore.notes: Weather-neutral year-round; price peaks follow Indian school holidays (May-Jun), Diwali, and Christmas/New Year. Most expensive per night on the list because hotels and attraction tickets (Sentosa, Universal, Gardens) are pricey. Listings (4N land, 3*): Tripoto Rs35,000 (~8.7k/n), TripCabinet Holiday Inn Atrium Rs47,999 (GST, visa extra), TravelTriangle from Rs49,250, Musafir Rs54,999-56,999. Visa: e-visa via authorised agent, govt ~Rs2,100 (SGD 30) + agent fee.

kualalumpur.notes: Hot/humid year-round with inter-monsoon rains Mar-Apr and Oct-Nov; demand peaks follow Indian holidays. Listings (5N KL+Langkawi/Genting land, 3*): TravelTriangle Rs20,000-24,000 (~4-5k/n), Musafir 3* Rs24,999, TourTravelWorld Rs34,833, Holidify Rs37,149 (~7.4k/n). Visa-free 30 days for Indians until 31 Dec 2026 (MDAC arrival card free) - check renewal for 2027; previous eVisa was ~Rs2,500-3,500.

langkawi.notes: Dry Dec-Apr; SW monsoon May-Oct (wettest Sep). Beach resorts cost more than KL city hotels. Listings (3N Langkawi, twin): TravelTriangle Rs20,000-30,000 (3* option Rs25,500 ~8.5k/n incl. visa), TourTravelWorld budget from Rs17,000 (~5.7k/n); Thomas Cook guide estimates Rs35-45k for 3 days (higher tier). Flights = India-KL return + ~Rs5-8k KL-Langkawi domestic return (no direct India flights).

dubai.notes: Winter Nov-Feb is peak (Dubai Shopping Festival Dec-Jan, New Year); Jun-Aug 40-45C but hotels 40-60% off (Dubai Summer Surprises). Listings (4N land): MakeMyTrip from Rs21,999 (summer low, ~5.5k/n), SOTC from Rs30,400, Musafir 'Winter in Dubai' 3* Rs33,900, Musafir 3* Rs40,999-47,999 (~10-12k/n, incl. desert safari, theme parks). Tourism Dirham (AED 10-15/room/night) usually extra. Visa: 30-day single-entry, govt ~Rs6,900 (AED 252+VAT), agents Rs7,800-10,000; VoA possible for Indians holding valid US/UK/EU visa.

abudhabi.notes: Same climate as Dubai; F1 Grand Prix (late Nov/early Dec) causes a sharp hotel spike. Thin Abu Dhabi-only data; derived from combo listings: Kiomoi Dubai+Abu Dhabi 5N from Rs49,400 (~9.9k/n), Indian Holiday 3N Dubai+2N AD 3* Rs68,500 (valid to Jul 2026, includes more tours), Musafir 4* Rs54,999. Ferrari World/Yas tickets are costly, which lifts sightseeing cost vs Dubai. Same UAE visa as Dubai; Etihad/IndiGo/Air India Express fly direct to AUH.
